title: BKT Parameter Lab
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Learning Analytics
Knowledge Tracing
Bayesian Statistics
Mastery Prediction
Probability
description: A p5.js lab in which learners set the four Bayesian knowledge tracing parameters and a sequence of correct and incorrect answers, watch the mastery estimate P(L) update after each answer with the conditioning and learning-step values shown, and judge when it first reaches a mastery threshold.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: Bayesian knowledge tracing parameters, update and mastery threshold
learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the mastery estimate after each answer in a sequence by choosing the four BKT parameters, and will judge when the estimate first reaches a chosen mastery threshold.
prerequisites: BKT parameters and the two-step update (Chapter 18)

accessibility.notes: Native sliders, buttons and checkbox; arrow keys select an attempt and F flips it; tiles carry check/cross glyphs as well as color-blind-safe colors

controls.label: Initial knowledge P(L0)
controls.purpose: Probability of mastery before any evidence

controls.label: Learning rate p_t
controls.purpose: Chance an unmastered learner masters the concept between opportunities

controls.label: Guess p_g
controls.purpose: Chance of a correct answer without mastery

controls.label: Slip p_s
controls.purpose: Chance of an incorrect answer despite mastery

controls.label: Mastery threshold
controls.purpose: Estimate at which the concept is treated as mastered

controls.label: Answer tiles
controls.purpose: Flip an answer between correct and incorrect

controls.label: Reset
controls.purpose: Restore the default sequence and parameters

controls.label: Show intermediate numbers
controls.purpose: Show conditioning and learning-step values for the selected attempt

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Parameter sliders with an editable answer sequence and live chart
keyQuestions: How does a higher guess parameter change the effect of a correct answer?
Why does one wrong answer lower but not zero the estimate?
At which attempt does the estimate first reach the threshold, and how does the threshold choice change that?
commonMisconceptions: The estimate is the fraction of correct answers
A single wrong answer proves the concept is not mastered
The mastery threshold is a fact about the learner rather than a policy
assessmentOpportunities: Hand calculation of one update, checked against the lab
Stating the first attempt at which a threshold is reached

simulation.model: Standard four-parameter Bayesian knowledge tracing (two-state hidden Markov model, no forgetting)
assumptions: Illustrative default parameters, not fitted to data
